runs.t: Understanding our environmental impact begins with measuring it. EFG Holding released its second Carbon Footprint Report - the first comprehensive assessment encompassing all its facilities and operations - covering the reporting period from January 1 to December 31, 2024. This year has been designated as the base year against which all future assessments will be benchmarked.
Understanding our environmental impact begins with measuring it. EFG Holding released its second

- the first comprehensive assessment encompassing all its facilities and operations - covering the reporting period from January 1 to December 31, 2024. This year has been designated as the base year against which all future assessments will be benchmarked.

This analysis provides the foundation for informed decision-making, targeted reduction initiatives, and transparent climate reporting, reinforcing our commitment to responsible growth and long-term environmental stewardship. Prepared in alignment with internationally recognized frameworks and methodologies, including the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories (with 2019 refinements), and the ISO 14064-1:2018 standard, the report systematically evaluates the Group’s greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions across the three internationally recognized scopes:
Direct emissions from EFG’s owned assets (e.g., fuel use in generators and company vehicles).
Indirect emissions from purchased energy, primarily electricity consumption.
Other indirect emissions from value-chain activities, including purchased goods and services, waste, water use, business travel, and employee commuting
